At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a baby.

HR Operations Specialist EMEA
We are looking for a colleague that will be responsible for delivering efficient, compliant,  HR operations across multiple countries within the EMEA region. This role serves as a key liaison between managers, employees, functional HR Business Partners, external payroll providers, and benefit vendors to ensure seamless execution of payroll, benefits, HR administration, and HR systems processes.
You will play a critical role in maintaining operational excellence, driving process improvements, and providing subject matter expertise across all aspects of HR operations.
You will be a part of the HR Operations team, reporting to Head of Total Rewards and be situated in Gothenburg in Sweden or Valencia in Spain.

Key responsibilities:
- Delivering accurate and compliant payroll and benefits administration across all assigned  countries
- Maintaining high-quality employee data and HR process integrity
- Manage HR administration throughout the employee lifecycle
- Ensure that HR Operational processes comply with local labor laws and company policies
- Independently drive and take ownership of your scope 
 To be successful in this position you would need:
· Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or Finance or relevant working experience
· 7+ years of experience in HR Operations, HR Administration, Payroll or Shared Services
· Demonstrated experience supporting multiple countries across EMEA
· Strong international HR operations experience, exceptional attention to detail,  and the ability to manage complex processes across multiple countries and vendors.
· Solid understanding of employee benefits, pensions and insurance programs
· Experience working with HRIS platforms such as Sage, HiBob, Workday or similar systems
· Strong experience managing outsourced payroll providers
· Good communication and collaboration skills
· Fluent in English and Swedish or Spanish, verbally and in writing
Preferred start date Mid-January 2027.
Interviews will be conducted continuously, and the position might be filled before last application date.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Vitrolife Group is a global provider of medical devices and genetic services. Based on science and advanced research capabilities, we develop services and products for personalized genetic information and medical device products. We support our customers by improving their clinical practice for the patient's outcome of fertility treatment.
We are currently approximately 1 100 colleagues worldwide, with headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. Vitrolife Group's products and services are available in more than 110 countries through our own presence in 30 countries and a network of distributors. Vitrolife Group is a sustainable market leader and aims to be the preferred partner for IVF-clinics by providing superior products and services with the vision of fulfilling the dream of having a baby. The Vitrolife share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Is it time for a change?
Are you looking for a better work–life balance, shorter commuting times, and close access to nature  without compromising on professional challenge and development? 
This opportunity may be the next step in your career!
We are a recruitment company supporting a well-established healthcare provider in Sweden in their search for a Specialist in Family Medicine/General Practice. The position is based in a scenic and nature-rich region, offering a safe and calm living environment with excellent opportunities for outdoor activities year-round, while still providing access to culture, services, and activities for the whole family.

The organization values teamwork, where the expertise of all professional groups is respected and utilized, and where patient-centered care is a priority.
Primary care in Sweden is continuously evolving, with an increased focus on:
accessible and patient-centered care
smart digital solutions
patient involvement and continuity of care
a sustainable and supportive work environment

The health center provides assessment, investigation, treatment, follow-up, and rehabilitation for patients of all ages and at all stages of life.
A varied and professionally rewarding position
The clinic has a broad primary care assignment, including both planned visits and acute assessments. This results in a diverse and stimulating clinical workload, where you will have the opportunity to fully utilize your medical expertise and experience. The role is demanding, but also highly rewarding, offering significant opportunities for professional growth and development.
What the workplace offers
In addition to a meaningful and stimulating role, the employer offers strong support for your long-term professional development and well-being:
Mentorship or professional guidance from an experienced colleague
Regular opportunities for professional development and continuing medical education
A work environment that promotes good health, including a wellness allowance

We are looking for you who
Are a certified Specialist in Family Medicine / General Practice
Enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams and value a holistic approach to patient care
Are motivated to contribute to high-quality primary care
Are interested in combining a professionally fulfilling role with a high quality of life

Qualifications:
EU-recognized specialist certification in Family Medicine
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish

At Tata Technologies, we make product development dreams a reality by designing, engineering, and validating the products of tomorrow for the world’s leading manufacturers. Due to our continued growth, we are now recruiting an Electrical Design Engineer to strengthen our engineering team.
Scope of Role
As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will be responsible for maintaining, updating, and validating electrical design documentation and calculations across multiple engineering platforms. The role ensures accuracy, consistency, and compliance with engineering standards across schematics, layouts, part lists, and system calculations. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to support electrical design integrity and system performance.
Main Responsibilities
Update and maintain electrical schematics and layouts, ensuring accurate location coding (EPLAN, AutoCAD).
Develop and modify electrical drawings according to project specifications.
Manage and validate electrical part lists, ensuring consistency and completeness of BOMs.
Extract and verify data generated from EPLAN outputs.
Perform and validate cable sizing and related calculations (El-vis tool).
Support energy consumption calculations and related documentation.
Maintain and update IP addressing within electrical documentation.
Perform and validate Performance Level (PL) calculations in line with safety standards (Sistema).
Develop and maintain electrical topology diagrams (Visio).
Ensure consistency of location codes across all tools and documentation platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with system architecture and engineering requirements.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
4 to 6 years of experience in electrical design engineering.
Strong knowledge of electrical system design, industrial automation, and control panel engineering.
Experience in developing and maintaining electrical schematics, layouts, and topology documentation.
Good understanding of electrical safety standards, Performance Level (PL), and risk reduction principles.
Experience working in industrial, manufacturing, or automotive environments.
Ability to work independently and collaborate within cross-functional teams.

Tools & Skills
EPLAN – electrical schematics and part list generation
AutoCAD – electrical layouts
El-vis – cable calculations
Sistema – performance level calculations
Visio – topology documentation
Strong knowledge of location code management and data consistency across tools
Experience working with global teams and customer-specific standards
Proficiency in English, both written and spoken

Personal Qualities
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Detail-oriented with a structured approach to work
Effective communication and collaboration skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment
Proactive and self-driven mindset
Comfortable working in cross-functional and international teams

If you are passionate about bringing innovation to the projects you work on then we would love to hear from you.
Tata Technologies: Engineering a better world.
Tata Technologies would like to thank all applicants for their interest; each application will be reviewed against the set criteria for the role. We would like to advise that only candidates under consideration will be contacted. If you do not hear from us within 10 working days following the closing date it will mean that unfortunately your application has not been successful. We will however retain your details for any suitable future opportunities.

Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.
Your role
As Proposal Manager, you will play a critical role in Saab's international Marketing & Sales activities. You will lead the proposal development process for complex international defence deals, ensuring high-quality submissions that meet customer requirements and position Saab competitively.

The role is focused on managing the end-to-end proposal process, coordinating inputs from technical, commercial and business teams.

You will work closely with Bid Managers, subject matter experts and stakeholders across Saab to deliver compelling proposals that showcase Saab's capabilities and value proposition.
Your responsibility spans four main areas:
Proposal Development - Lead the creation and assembly of competitive proposals, ensuring completeness, quality and consistency, ensuring that all contributors understand their responsibilities and deliver their input according to plan
Cross-functional Coordination - Coordinate inputs from technical, commercial, legal and financial teams to produce integrated proposals.
Quality Assurance - Ensure proposals meet customer requirements and follow Saab's standards for content, format and presentation.
Timeline Management - Manage proposal deliverables, ensuring that it is complete, compliant, professionally presented and submitted on time.
Your profile
We are looking for a structured and detail-oriented professional who thrives in a complex international business environment. You enjoy bringing people together and ensuring that proposals are delivered with the highest quality and on time.
To succeed in this role, we see that you:
Have experience of managing proposals, bids or complex business documents.
Have strong collaborative and communication skills.
Are comfortable working across organisational boundaries and engaging with a wide range of stakeholders.

Have excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Have a "doer" mindset and take ownership from idea to execution.
Are fluent in English and Swedish.
Have curiosity and openness to technological development, with an interest in AI-based tools and methods.

Aspirational mindset with potential to grow into roles as Bid Manager, Bid Center Manager or other roles in sales.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be a part of
Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring mission, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 26,100 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. jobs.description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

JOB DESCRIPTION

Would you like to help build a growing executive search and specialist recruitment business in the Nordic defence and security sector?

In this role, you will develop client relationships, identify new business opportunities and lead recruitment assignments for organisations operating in a fast-growing and highly competitive industry. You will work closely with both clients and candidates, building a strong understanding of their needs and the people who can help move their organisations forward.

You will take ownership of your market and have the opportunity to shape your own position. This means staying close to the industry, learning continuously and taking an active role in conversations with companies and candidates across the Nordics and internationally.

The role combines business development with the delivery of high-quality search assignments. 

Din Profil

PROFILE

You are curious about the defence and security sector and genuinely motivated to understand the industry, its organisations and the people who work in it. Previous experience from the defence industry is not essential. What matters is that you are keen to learn, read up on the sector and enjoy building relationships with people who work in complex and important fields.

You are confident in client-facing situations and able to earn trust in a demanding environment. You take responsibility, put the client first and understand the importance of careful, professional relationship management with both clients and candidates. You are comfortable working internationally and collaborating across cultures.

We believe you will bring:

- Experience in a commercial, consulting, recruitment or other client-facing role
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills
- A genuine interest in people and in developing a deep understanding of the industries you serve
- A proactive, accountable and curious approach to your work
- The ability to communicate fluently in Swedish and English
- A valid B-category driving licence

We value sound judgement, maturity and personal drive. Your ability to build confidence, follow through and represent the business with professionalism matters as much as your years of experience.

Om företaget

ABOUT US

Defence Executive is being built as a Nordic executive search and specialist recruitment business focused on the defence and security sector. We are part of an established recruitment team with experience across several specialist industries, and we work closely together while each person develops their own market.

Our team has worked with some of the largest international defence groups, and we are a strategic partner. Joining us means helping to develop a growing Nordic platform with an established team and a recognised foundation in specialist recruitment. You will have room to be creative, build your own position and help shape how we work in the industry.

We are based in attractive offices on Drottninggatan in central Stockholm.

Kontaktuppgifter

CONTACT

Interested in helping build the next chapter of Defence Executive? Please submit your application and CV through the application form.

We look forward to hearing from people who are curious about the industry, passionate about building relationships and motivated to create long-term value for clients and candidates.

You will serve as a key point of contact for users of the company’s proprietary business system. We are looking for someone who can start immediately. The assignment will initially last six months, with strong opportunities for both extension and permanent employment. You will be based at the modern office in central Stockholm,.
With the possibility to work from home two days per week.

An assignment at a leading company within the accounting industry
A close-knit team with a welcoming and inclusive culture, as well as an engaged Group Manager
Opportunities for skills development in customer service case management with a focus on IT and finance

jobs.occupation: We are looking for an Experienced Hardware Lead Engineer!
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about high-performance electronics, embedded systems, and cutting-edge engine technology? Join our client’s innovative engineering team where your expertise in hardware design will directly impact next-generation technology. Apply today, as we review applications on an ongoing basis!
About the role
Our client is a specialist and market leader in advanced electronic engine management systems, Vessel/Vehicle control systems and Power distribution modules. They develop the hardware and software that optimizes performance, reduces fuel consumption, and lowers emissions for everything from marine and automotive applications to industrial engines running on renewable fuels and next- generation hybrid/electric systems with a legacy of high-octane motorsport.
As a Hardware Engineer, you will play an important role creating next-generation Electronic Control Units (ECUs). You will join a collaborative, highly technical engineering team where your work has a direct impact. Your market will be truly global, supporting customers across the EU, US, India, and the UK from initial specification all the way to mass production.
Work tasks
In this role, you will own the hardware development lifecycle. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality products on time and within scope. Your main responsibilities will include:
Group Lead: Work with daily planning and cost estimations and follow up of deliverables.
HW System Engineering: Designing an efficient System/ ECU layout to reaach safety, Performance and cost demands. This includes understanding the ECU outside environment and Performance requirements.
Future Concept: Define Next generation HW module solutions.
End-to-End Hardware Design: Developing specifications, schematics, component configurations, and PCB designs for advanced ECUs.
Documentation & Strategy: Creating Bill of Materials (BOM) and documented design strategies, including hardware design descriptions and precise calculations.
Design Verification: Ensuring technical excellence through rigorous testing and verification phases.
Customer Collaboration: Acting as a technical bridge for clients worldwide. This includes understanding their needs, supporting them from prototyping to certification, and occasionally traveling to client sites to help implement the products firsthand.

We are looking for
A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a similar field
A few years of experience in Hardware Engineering – preferably within a company in the automotive industry
Previous experience as a group Lead – daily planning and follow up of deliverables
Solid knowledge of embedded systems hardware
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken

It is meritorious if you have experience in:
Power electronics development
Emotor control
Unmanned Vessels/Vehicles
Low level software: HardWare InterFace (HWIF) and eTPU coding
Establishing and maintaining customer relations

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Over the last five years, Akind Finance has transitioned into a centralized function. Today, we support operations across Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, Germany, and from 2027, Switzerland. Our portfolio of brands includes Academic Work, Winona, Brights, and Crowd Collective. Work tasks
You will hold the overall responsibility for all financial flows related to client and supplier payments.
You will provide visible, accessible leadership through regular dialogue, coaching, constructive feedback, and cross-training.
You will drive process improvements by continuously streamlining, standardizing, harmonizing, and automating our AP/AR end-to-end processes.
You will continuously streamline, standardize, and automate the AP/AR processes.

You will deliver responsive, professional support to internal stakeholders, customers, and consultants while improving handovers.

We are looking for
To succeed in this role, you are a confident, approachable, and low-ego leader. You create trust through presence, clarity, and consistent follow-through. You communicate openly, address challenges directly, and help people understand both what needs to change and why. Above all, you enjoy developing people and building a team that shares knowledge and supports one another. You also naturally align with our core values: Show Heart, Share Energy, and Beat Yesterday.  
Required experience & background:
You have proven people leadership experience, including direct responsibility for a team, coaching, performance follow-up, and competence development.
You have a sound operational understanding of financial flows and experience from AP, AR, Invoicing, Credit Management, or a related transaction-intensive function.

Meritorious experience:

Background in a complex, multi-company, or international organization.
Practical experience with automation, digitalization, system implementation, or AI-supported process improvement.
Additional language skills, particularly Finnish, German, or French.

We look forward to receiving your application!

As a Real Estate Facility Manager with us, you are responsible for managing both leased and owned premises and maintain daily contact with the operations that take place in these facilities. You have budget responsibility and ensure that maintenance plans are developed and implemented. You act as a requirements setter in construction projects and coordinate property-related matters. jobs.occupation: Advance Your Career as a Consultant Pathologist in Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in pathology looking for a role where you can combine advanced diagnostics with a balanced lifestyle?
We are currently seeking specialist surgical pathologists to join a modern and accredited department in central Sweden, located in a region known for its coastal setting, rich history, and strong connection to nature.
About the Department
The surgical pathology and cytology unit plays a central role in diagnostics by analyzing tissue and cell samples using both microscopy and advanced digital systems. The goal is to provide accurate and timely diagnostic support to clinicians, improving patient outcomes and safety.
The department is part of a larger organization within laboratory medicine and is at the forefront of digital pathology, with ongoing development in automation, robotics, and AI-driven diagnostics.
In addition to histopathology and cytology, the unit is also responsible for:
Gynecological screening programs
Autopsy services and morgue operations
Multidisciplinary clinical conferences
You will work in a collaborative and well-structured environment with experienced colleagues across multiple disciplines.
Your role
As a specialist surgical pathologist, your work will include:
Diagnostic work in histopathology and cytology
Gross examination and specimen handling
Participation in clinical conferences and interdisciplinary discussions
Autopsy
Supervising and mentoring residents

Daytime on-call service for urgent diagnostic cases is shared within the team.
Qualifications
EU-recognized specialist certification in pathology
Experience in surgical pathology
Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-based environment
A structured, collaborative, and flexible approach

Why work here?
This opportunity is located in a coastal region of central Sweden, offering a unique mix of professional development and quality of life. The area is known for:
Easy access to the sea, forests, and outdoor activities year-round
A rich industrial and cultural heritage
A safe and family-friendly environment
Good infrastructure with connections to larger cities
The working environment is modern, forward-thinking, and continuously evolving, providing excellent conditions for both professional growth and long-term career development.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype
Take the next step in your career
This is an excellent opportunity for surgical pathologists who want to work in a progressive environment while enjoying a high quality of life.
Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?
Don’t hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you and helping you find the perfect job that matches your experience and ambitions.
Apply now!

jobs.occupation: Exciting Radiologist Position in the Heart of Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a board-certified radiologist looking for a new challenge in a beautiful part of Sweden?
This position combines professional development with a high quality of life in a scenic region known for its lakes, forests and outdoor lifestyle.
About the hospital and department
The radiology department is part of the Diagnostic Imaging and Functional Medicine division and performs around 24,000 examinations annually. The unit is equipped with two ultrasound machines, one MRI, one CT scanner and two conventional X-ray systems (one with fluoroscopy). Both acute and planned diagnostic services are provided in modern facilities with continuously updated technology.
You will join a skilled and stable team of radiologists, radiographers, nurses and administrative staff. Staff turnover among doctors has been close to zero in recent years. The department is also preparing for a major upgrade of both premises and equipment in the near future.
Tasks and responsibilities
Broad diagnostic radiology including conventional X-ray, ultrasound and CT.
Participation in both acute and planned care.
Collaboration with other clinical specialties.
On-call duties are possible but not mandatory (primarily organised from a nearby hospital).

Requirements
Specialist certification in radiology from an EU/EEA country, recognised by EU directive 2005/36/EC.
Several years of clinical experience preferred, but not mandatory.
Skills in ultrasound and CT required; fluoroscopy and interventional procedures are a plus.
Good command of English. Willingness to learn Swedish to minimum B2/C1 level (language training provided).

Personal profile
Cooperative and a team player, while able to work independently.
Flexible and adaptable in a changing clinical environment.
Service-minded and attentive in patient interaction.
Proactive and quality-focused.

Terms and conditions
Full-time, Monday–Friday, daytime hours.
Competitive salary
Permanent employment in the Swedish public healthcare system.
Relocation package and intensive Swedish language training included.

Why this location?
The hospital is located in the heart of Hälsingland, a region offering a unique combination of professional challenges and an exceptional quality of life. Here you will find affordable housing, short commutes, and endless opportunities for outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing, and fishing – all within reach of a modern healthcare environment.
Application process
Please send a complete application including:
CV and cover letter
Diplomas and specialist certificate
Employment references
Information on your availability to start language training and relocation

EU/EEA candidates only. Swedish medical license and specialist recognition from the National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen) are required before independent practice. Support will be provided throughout this process.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Swedish Speaking Online Content Moderator/Customer Support Agent
jobs.description:
Besedo is a Swedish company with offices in five locations around the world, providing content 
moderation solutions to leading online marketplaces, dating sites, and sharing economy services. 
Our automation tool, Implio, facilitates fast and easy moderation, often in combination with our 
manual services.  Besedo is a very multicultural company, and it shows through our employees, 
who between them, boast a range of 17 different languages. Besedo is a fast-growing tech
company providing tools and services to online marketplaces around the world. 
At Besedo, our moderation teams are at the core of our business and essential to our success. 
We invest in our co-workers and love to see you grow with the company. In fact, 50% of our 
managers and experts started as content moderators. 
Join a vibrant, international team in Malta, dedicated to making the internet a safer place for all! 

Job description:  
Your Role and Responsibilities:  
-Supporting users and answer their questions via email 
-Reviewing and moderating ads and user-profiles, with high accuracy at a fast pace 
-Participating in regular training sessions to learn and maintain expert knowledge of 
publication rules, market trends and moderation best practices 
-Collaborating with your team members

You are our eyes and ears and you know the users the best! 
-Giving input on improvements of publication rules to improve user experiences

and their users

plus

-A stimulating and rewarding job in a fast-moving, innovative and international tech
company.

At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a Customer Operations & Loan Specialist (DACH Region) for the next phase of growth.
About the Role
You will directly impact small business growth by evaluating credit applications and guiding German-speaking entrepreneurs through tailored financing solutions. This role bridges direct customer engagement with financial assessment, giving you end-to-end ownership of customer onboarding and credit execution in a rapidly scaling market.
Key responsibilities
Evaluate business loan applications by analyzing operational performance and credit risk in partnership with underwriting.

Manage high-volume customer inquiries across phone, chat, and email to ensure fast and transparent loan processing.

Structure customized financing proposals that align with applicant business models and cash flow requirements.

Develop long-term customer relationships through proactive account management and product portfolio adoption.

Transition into full credit underwriting authority to independently approve and manage small business loans over time.

What we’re looking for
You bring a structured, analytical approach to problem-solving and excel at building trust with business owners. You are motivated by operational ownership, adapt quickly to changing priorities, and want to contribute to building robust customer operations frameworks.
Qualifications
Native-level or fluent professional proficiency in German, alongside strong working proficiency in English.

Practical background in customer operations, client management, or sales within financial services or fintech.

Foundational experience analyzing financial statements, credit data, or business metrics.

Educational background in business, economics, finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Why Qred?
This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
One Last Thing
This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
